findings.explanation: Manifest control entries use key_event:"tap", but the schema only accepts "press"/"down"/"up" (contract finding). With an uninterpretable control descriptor the harness cannot map/dispatch the touch actions, so START never fires: every scenario run fails at L1 with status="menu" and game_started missing. This is the root cause of the universal start failure and the contract conformance failure.

START and RESTART buttons are bound only to 'click', while #fruit and #bomb also have 'touchstart' handlers. The brief defines all four controls as touch operations and the harness drives them via touch; under a touch-only dispatch the start/restart handlers never fire. This is an inconsistency in the input wiring (the developer added touchstart to fruit/bomb but omitted it for start/restart), a latent defect independent of the manifest issue.

Plan steps 1/2 require PRNG-derived appearance delays forming a fixed, virtual-time-advanceable schedule ("所有时间规则使用毫秒，并能由虚拟时间推进"). The implementation shows the first fruit immediately on start and keeps the bomb always present, with no timed schedule and no setTimeout-based appearance. The implementation summary itself admits this deviation. So the brief's timed-schedule / virtual-time requirement is not met, though this path was never exercised because L1 start failed first.

limits: Root cause of the start failure is ambiguous between the invalid manifest key_event (harness cannot interpret the touch action) and the missing touchstart handlers on start/restart; both are present and either alone can defeat control execution.
L2/L3 (gameplay process and HUD/UI certification) were never reached because L1 start failed in all 9 runs; the timing/schedule requirement therefore has no runtime evidence either way.

The 3 'final passes' are all restart-path lucky passes (final_outcome_correct=true but lucky_pass_detected=true): the game never started, so its state coincidentally matched the expected post-restart menu, not a real playthrough.

Functional logic after a successful start (scoring, win at 5 fruits/score 50, lose at 3rd bomb, post-game lock, restart reset) appears correct by code inspection but was never exercised by the certified browser run.
